# Buildings reference

Every method of the buildings resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Structure

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `find()`: [`Building`](#building)
  - `units()`: `list<`[`BuildingUnit`](#buildingunit)`>`
  - `location()`: `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
    - `credits()`: `?`[`Credits`](shared.md#credits)

## Methods

<a name="buildings-methods"></a>
### `Buildings`

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `withBagPandId(string $bagPandId)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the building with the BAG pand id. |
| `find()` | [`Building`](#building) | Building and its units |
| `withMaxCacheAge(int $seconds)` | `static` | Returns a copy that keeps answers at most this many seconds in the cache. |
| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |

## Response objects

Every object implements the interface of the same name in `Contracts\DTO`.

<a name="building"></a>
### `Building`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `bagPandId()` | `string` | `bag_pand_id` | The BAG pand id of the building. |
| `constructionYear()` | `?int` | `construction_year` | The construction year of the building. |
| `bagStatus()` | `?string` | `bag_status` | The status of the building in the BAG. |
| `unitsCount()` | `int` | `units_count` | The number of units in the building. |
| `residentialUnitsCount()` | `int` | `residential_units_count` | The number of residential units in the building. |
| `units()` | `list<`[`BuildingUnit`](#buildingunit)`>` | `units` | The units in the building. |
| `location()` | `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location) | `location` | The coordinates of the building. |
| `street()` | `?string` | `street` | The street. |
| `postcode()` | `?string` | `postcode` | The postcode. |
| `city()` | `?string` | `city` | The city. |
| `meta()` | `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta) | `meta` | The metadata of the answer. |

<a name="buildingunit"></a>
### `BuildingUnit`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `bagId()` | `?string` | `bag_id` | The BAG id of the address of the unit. |
| `houseNumber()` | `?int` | `house_number` | The house number. |
| `houseNumberExt()` | `?string` | `house_number_ext` | The extension of the house number. |
| `floorLevel()` | `?int` | `floor_level` | The floor the unit is on. |
| `livingAreaInSquareMeters()` | `?int` | `living_area_m2` | The living area of the unit. |
| `objectType()` | `?string` | `object_type` | The kind of object, such as an apartment. |
| `isResidential()` | `?bool` | `is_residential` | Whether the unit is a home. |
